title: VoidBlock
description: This is a Sky-block Esque Data pack, rather than spawning on a normal island, you spawn with just a chest and some spawners. Which opens the door for so much more advancement!
body:
### Void Block is a skyblock related data pack 
here's all of the features in this pack:
  **1 Main starting island:**
-   The player spawns on the chest underneith the chest is 2 trial spawners and two trial vaults,
-   1 vault is ominous the other is regular
-   The trial spawners spawn wandering traders, and breeze, which makes it much easier to advance
-   Under the spawners is water to make sure you don't get spawned camp at the start
-   Under that is a wool covered shrieker
-   and under that is 1 end portal

**Nothing else will generate**

Both the nether and End are empty 
(the ender pillars, and portal will generate)

**Biomes and structures bounding boxes will generate normally**

_There is also a simple addtion which prevents Vaults from locking the player out, allowing them to unlock it as many times as they want_
